users.title: Users
users.subtitle: Profiles behind the identity layer: linked channel handles, today's quota, and the per-user model and instruction layer. Requires runtime.identity.enabled.
users.meta: {n, plural, one {# profile} other {# profiles}} · quota day {day} (UTC)
users.filterPlaceholder: Filter by name, email or id
users.emptyList: Nobody has registered. Issue an invite, or let users register through /v1/users.
users.selectHint: Select a profile to see its handles, usage and audit trail.
users.quota.title: Quota
users.quota.subtitle: Day {day} (UTC). The limit is the profile's own, or usage.default_tokens_per_day.
users.handles.title: Linked handles
users.handles.subtitle: A person links a handle by sending /link <code> from it. The last handle cannot be unlinked.
users.handles.lastCannotUnlink: The last handle cannot be unlinked
users.projects.title: File projects
users.projects.subtitle: The user-scoped file store (files.*).
users.calls.title: Recent calls
users.calls.subtitle: Per-call detail (usage.events), last 7 days.
users.audit.title: Audit trail
users.audit.subtitle: The core-owned message journal for this person, newest first.
users.limit.title: Daily token limit
users.limit.subtitle: Billable tokens (input + output) per UTC day. 0 or empty inherits usage.default_tokens_per_day.
users.limit.label: Tokens per day
users.limit.invalid: enter a whole number of tokens, 0 or more
users.unlink.title: Unlink handle
users.unlink.message:
Detach the {channel} handle "{handle}" from this profile?

That handle loses the personal scope until it is linked again.
users.delete.message: This purges the profile, its handles, usage, journal rows and files. Memory rows follow their store retention. It cannot be undone. Type the user id to confirm.
users.delete.label: User id
users.delete.mismatch: type the exact user id to confirm
users.settings.title: Model & instructions
users.settings.subtitle: Per-person layer on top of every agent this person talks to.
users.settings.modelHint: Overrides the agent's model for this person's turns. Which model a person runs on is a cost decision, so only an operator can set it.
users.settings.instructionsHint: Appended to the agent's instructions for this person (agent.info().instructions). Empty clears it.
users.settings.saved: settings saved · applies from the next turn
users.inviteDialog.title: Registration invite
users.inviteDialog.subtitle: Give this code to the person; it is not shown again.
users.inviteDialog.registrationNote: Invites matter when runtime.users.registration is invite; with open registration anyone can register without one.
